hero.desc.0: How Gausin International Engineers collects, uses, and protects your information.
p.0: How Gausin International Engineers collects, uses, and protects your information.
p.1: When you contact us for industrial equipment, project discussions, service support, or quotations, we may collect:
p.2: We process data based on your consent (form submissions), legitimate business interest (B2B communication and support), and legal obligations (tax/compliance records).
p.3: We do not sell personal data. We may share limited information with trusted service providers (hosting, communication, CRM, accounting) only as needed to operate our business. We may also disclose data if required by law or competent authority.
p.4: Inquiry and business communication data is retained for as long as needed for project engagement, support, and legal/commercial recordkeeping. Non-essential marketing communication can be opted out at any time.
p.5: We use practical administrative and technical safeguards to protect data against unauthorized access, alteration, or misuse. However, no online transmission/storage method is absolutely risk-free.
p.6: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies for session management, performance tracking, and user experience improvements. You can disable cookies via browser settings, though some features may be affected.
p.7: You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal data shared with us, subject to legal and contractual obligations. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.
p.8: We may revise this Privacy Policy to reflect legal, technical, or operational changes. The latest version will always be published on this page with the revised effective date.
